div.head: Abt 54
div.ab: Gif þuman of aslæhð, XX sciƚƚ.
Wenn [jemand] einen Daumen abhaut, [büsse er] 20 Schill.
If [someone] cuts off a thumb, [let him pay] 20 shillings.
If a thumb is struck off, 20 shillings [shall be paid as compensation].
If [a person] strikes off a thumb, 20 shillings.

note.seg: Das of (s. d. Wb II 2) kann Adverb sein; Toller verwirft ofaceapian, ofaceorfan, of(a)don, ofadrifan, ofasciere, óf(a)slean, ofswerian, nimmt aber ofsacan auf. Doch bildet der Agsachse ofcyrf, und Ælfric wollte amputo, abscido schwerlich in 3 Wörtern ic of aceorfe glossiert haben, da aceorfe allein auch schon diese Bed. besitzt; er hätte dann auch of dem Verb nachgesetzt

The of (see that word in Wb II 2) may be an adverb; Toller rejects ofaceapian, ofaceorfan, of(a)don, ofadrifan, ofasciere, óf(a)slean, ofswerian, but admits ofsacan. Yet Anglo-Saxon does form ofcyrf, and Ælfric would hardly have meant amputo, abscido to be glossed with three words, ic of aceorfe, since aceorfe alone already has this meaning; besides, he would then have placed of after the verb
Die Summe der Bussen für die Finger (s. d. Gl 3; Gliederbussen 4c. 5b) ergibt ¹/₂ Wergeld, ebenso bei Baiern I 4. 11, Alemannen (Pact. II 16—23) und nahezu Jüten; Wilda 768

The compensations for the fingers (see that word in Gl 3; Gliederbussen 4c. 5b) add up to ¹/₂ wergild, as they also do among the Bavarians I 4. 11 and the Alemanni (Pact. II 16—23), and nearly so among the Jutes; Wilda 768
